observations: A solid black rounded figure sits centered on a flat black ground, its silhouette divided into a wide lower body, two small rounded ear-like bumps at the top, and four stubby limbs resting at the base.
Two spiral eyes and a jagged zigzag mouth are drawn in yellow-orange lines inside the black silhouette, the only warm marks against the flat black mass.
Dark red zigzag and wavy lines radiate outward from behind the figure across a bright yellow-green background, fanning from tight vertical bursts at the top to longer horizontal waves at the sides.
reading: A squat black form sits low against a sharp yellow-green field, its spiral eyes and serrated mouth reading as agitation or menace. The radiating red lines spread like heat or noise around it, while the flat black ground anchors the figure in stillness. The contrast between that stillness and the surrounding scatter of lines gives the image its tension.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, this work sits between title neighbors nnxyz nnotb #60 and nnxyz nnotb #62. The palette shifts across the three — olive with yellow lines in #60, bright green with red lines here, then gold with white border and no radiating lines in #62.

connections.reason: nnxyz nnotb #60 uses the same layout — black silhouette on a green ground with a flat black lower band and radiating zigzag lines — but its lines are yellow on olive rather than red on bright green, making the two a direct color-contrast pair.

nnxyz nnotb #96 shares the rounded black silhouette with yellow interior face marks, but places the figure small in a corner with no radiating lines, offering a quieter version of the black-figure-with-drawn-face motif.

lookingQuestion: Where exactly do the radiating lines change from tight vertical zigzags to longer horizontal waves, and does that shift follow the outline of the figure or the edges of the image?
ambiguities: The red radiating lines could be read as emanating from behind the figure or as drawn on top of the background independently; the layering is not fully resolved from the image alone.
nnxyz nnotb #62 shares the rounded black silhouette motif but its composition differs substantially — corner placement, white border, no radiating lines — so #60 is the stronger formal comparison.
